_judged_help: A judged variable has no global dataset. For each candidate, the team reads a source and enters how well it matches the target: 1 = same kind of feature, 0.5 = partly, 0 = absent. Always give a note and a source. Leave a variable out when unknown; it is then skipped, not counted as zero.
